title: Security Deposit Account Per-Fob Charges for Parking Access Fobs
content:
The per-fob charge for an unreturned fob on a Security Deposit Account follows the parking the fob opened, as shown by the household's Parking License:

| Parking License held by the household | Per-fob charge |
|---|---|
| Structured Garage Space | 95.00 USD |
| Private Detached Garage | 95.00 USD |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | 85.00 USD |
| Surface Unreserved Permit, Surface Reserved Space or Covered Carport Space | the program's unreturned fob charge |
| no Parking License | the program's unreturned fob charge |

**Records read.** The Parking License product the household held, from its Parking License record.

**Use.** The per-fob charge is multiplied by the number of fobs charged.

**Hypothetical cases.**

- Two fobs charged, and the household held a Private Detached Garage license: 2 times 95.00 is 190.00 USD.
- Two fobs charged, and the household held an EV Charging Reserved Space license: 2 times 85.00 is 170.00 USD.
